title: rule-proposal
description: Map to issue: a new symptom rule for an existing issue type, or (Admins only) for a new issue type created with it. A Tier 2 user's rule waits for an Admin; an Admin's goes live at once.

newIssueType.description: Admins only: create this issue type and map the error to it in one step.

severity.description: How serious this symptom is, overriding the issue type's own: major alerts show on the home page and in the Alerts tab, minor ones only on their cabinet. Omitted: the issue type's severity.

regroup.description: Move matching open unrecognized alerts under the issue when the rule goes live.

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action.
